notes.title: Added Project Re:VOLVE Playtest Demo to Branch
notes.notes:
Hello lovely playtesters!

I've gone ahead and added my other game Project Re:VOLVE as a launch option for Silent Utopia's playtest. As we reach the end of Silent Utopia's development all together, I want to include something else for you all to play as well.

This will be temporary, as I need more money to get a new Steam AppID for the game, but for now it will be playable in Silent Utopias launch options.

KEEP IN NOTE:
This game only works with a full KB + mouse! Debug is enabled as well...
It is playable to play on the SteamDeck or with controller by setting the appropriate bindings in Steams controller settings.
This other game isn't planned to release for another 2 - 3 years, despite its development time being double of what Silent Utopias was...

Anywho, keep out for grammar errors and report them to me in this game! I'm trying to squash all these misspellings of things and bugs and glitches as fast as I can while simultaneously working on Silent Utopia.

Also, important debug keys to keep note of:

INS + DEL = Move up and down a room, will softlock during cutscenes where flags must be enabled.
R = Restart a bugged room, it restarts the entire room even during cutscenes. Only exception is text input.
F1 = No clip
F3 = Instant death in some rooms, please avoid at all costs.
1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,0,-,+ = Various room specific debugs, also avoid at all costs.


Thank you for playing, I hope you enjoy this other work of mine!

notes.title: CONTROLLER SUPPORT (FIRST BATCH)
notes.notes:
Hello!
Based on user feedback, I've added a much overdue controller support update. Now the game works natively with all controllers (hopefully) and doesn't rely on Steams input translation.

Because of this, I now have access to modulating controller vibrations! Now when you hit enemies, graze, use your special, etc, the controller will vibrate!
I tried my best to make grazing feel as natural as possible, it's based on SIZE and SPEED of each bullet, as well as taking account for the bullet collision count. It also depends on what character you are using!
This should make dodging patterns hopefully easier...

Oh-! And I changed LOTSA attacks to feel smoother, as well as adding new Boss SP Attack types.

notes.title: slight beautification patch + revival of secret boss
notes.notes:
If you didn't know already, there's a hidden boss deep within the game... I won't give any hints, but you literally need to break the game in order to get to him! [i](I want hackers to find something fun...)[/i]
... Anyways! I created this super advanced attack shield thing with a bunch of weird math for him that is entirely objectID based! I wanted Tarsus's fight to last out longer without giving him extra HP, so it gives you JUST enough HP to defeat him with to reach his true final attack at the last second. Let me know what you all think of this!!

Also, I changed Taro's sprite a bit on the home screen so he pops out more, he almost looks like a little sticker now! :]
